thread:
sara: Quick summary — postmortem for last week's authz outage highlighted three recurring gaps: intermittent token validation failures in long-lived sessions, missing audit events for fallback auth paths, and at least two service accounts with stale secrets. Proposing a focused 10-business-day remediation sweep + a standing weekly short sync until we hit 4 consecutive green runs.
sara: Who can own the sweep and break into: validation tests, audit coverage, secret rotation?
diego: I can own validation tests. Plan: add end-to-end probes that hit long-lived sessions and add a daily smoke job. ETA: 4 workdays to get probes merging.
jen: I can take audit coverage — will map fallback paths that bypass main middleware and add logging hooks. Need 6 days for instrumentation + 2 days for rollout.
maya: I'll coordinate secrets rotation for the two service accounts and scan for TTL drift elsewhere. Will need credentials handoff with security. Target: rotation within 7 days, then automated TTL alerts.
sara: Great. Can each owner add a single-page checklist in the postmortem doc and link PRs here? Also we need a rollback plan for each change.
diego: Adding checklist now. Quick note: the long-lived token probe needs an env var to simulate token reuse — patch in staging-only config.
infra-bot: deploy scheduled: canary config update to staging for token-probe on 3337780000 by diego.
jen: For audit logs, I'll add a middleware shim that emits a trace_id to existing audit stream; low-risk canary first. If signal is noisy, we'll back out.
ryan: I'll help with rollout cadence and build the runbook snippet for oncall — what to look for in SLI regressions. Will also add a Grafana panel for token-validation failure rates.
sara: Timeline check: diego + jen + maya align on start tomorrow EOD sync. Owners to post PR links here. Weekly sync W/ ops for 15m every Tue until closed.
diego: FYI — found one lib that retries auth on 401 without tagging telemetry. Adding explicit tag in retry path. Patch ready, will PR this afternoon.
jen: PR for audit shim opened: github.com/redwood/infrakit/pull/4789 — needs staging test.
maya: Secrets rotation plan: rotate svc-account-ml and svc-ingest. I'll request short-lived creds and schedule rotation window 3337792000-3337795600 UTC. Security to approve.
sara: Security approval needed: @security please ack the rotation window and the plan to revoke old creds after 48 hours.
security-bot: Approval requested by maya for rotation window 3337792000-3337795600 UTC. Please review: https://redwood.sec/rotations/987
security-bot: auto-note: rotation policy applied; manual approval required if any dependent services lack automated credential refresh.
security: Acknowledged. We'll review dependency list within 6 hours.
dry-run: small note — run the token-probe against the cached KV vs. non-cached path to ensure cache invalidation doesn't cause false negatives.
diego: Good catch. Will run both.
jen: Instrumentation checklist posted in the doc: https://docs.redwood.com/postmortems/authz-2026-03-instrum (linked PRs in comments).
ryan: Created Grafana panel and alert: token_validation_failure_rate > 0.5% for 5m triggers incident-low. Panel: https://grafana.redwood/d/abc123/token-validation
sara: Ownership summary: validation=diego, audit=jen, secrets=maya, runbook=ryan. I will act as PM owner to coordinate. Please update thread with PRs and when staging passes.
diego: PR merged to staging. Probe cron scheduled.
jen: Audit shim canary deployed to 5% of traffic in staging.
maya: Rotation executed for svc-account-ml; ingestion rotation pending dry-run verification.
sara: After rotation and probes green for 72h, we'll mark items as complete. If any regressions show, owners to escalate to postmortem backfill.
ryan: Weekly reminder set: calendar invite created "Authz Sweep: Tue 15m" recurring until canceled.
infra-bot: canary metrics: token-probe success rate 98.7% in staging (last 2h).
diego: Seeing a small spike in retry-tagged auths at 11:03; pushing fix to ensure retries carry trace_id.
jen: Audit shim logs present for fallback auth path in staging — good signal.
maya: Ingest rotation completed 3337795400. Old creds revoked 3337860000 as planned.
sara: Closing criteria: 72h green probes, audit events for fallback paths in production, rotated service account keys and TTL alerts in place. If all met, I'll close the postmortem follow-up and add these items to the security runbook.
jen: One follow-up: add an automated test that verifies audit events are emitted for a synthetic fallback path; adding to backlog.
diego: I'll schedule a short opt-in for infra teams to enable the token-probe in their envs.
ryan: I'll document the SLO delta and the runbook steps in the oncall playbook.
sara: Thanks all. Reopen this thread if something new pops up or paste PR/CI links. :thumbsup:
